title.narrative: Advance Integrated Urban Water Management (IUWM) to help cities address growing water challenges

description.narrative: With more than half of the Asia Pacific population living in urban areas, UNESCO will support Member States in the region in adopting sustainable water management strategies that balance development needs with environmental conservation. Through research, policy guidance, and capacity-building initiatives, UNESCO will promote innovative solutions that enhance water efficiency, resilience, and equitable access in urban settings. This proposal will support ongoing UNESCO work on water quality in Singapore, scientific based approaches for sustainable water management in Vietnam and support the UNESCO Kabul office in their water heritage Karez system in Afghanistan, used in arid regions to transport groundwater from mountain aquifers to fields and settlements.
